b1: Every enterprise has more ideas than it can build.
b2: Put AI inside ideation, and every idea can become a software system.
b4: An enterprise needs a system it trusts in production.
b5: Akka is an AI platform that turns any idea into a system that is ready for production, and keeps it trustworthy once it runs.
b6: Only Akka combines the path from an idea to a specification, the pipeline that builds and checks the system, and the runtime the system is built for.
b7: Because the runtime is known before any code is generated, AI writes less, and reviewers review less.
b9: Every idea gets its own software factory.
b10: Akka is the platform for enterprise ideAItion.
